prompt: Create exactly one 9:16 vertical style reference sheet — a texture and palette sample, not a scene. Medium: monochrome illustration. Texture family: smooth matte off-white paper with extremely light natural tooth. Palette: predominantly bone-white ground and soft carbon-black linework, with cool graphite-gray micro-accents and extremely sparse abyssal cyan reserved for bioluminescence, transparent anatomy, or one key adaptation per frame. Line treatment: clean confident monoline contours with rounded joins, playful continuous-line transitions, simplified anatomical shapes, sparse hatching only where depth is essential, no heavy filled shadows. Lighting: flat diffuse illustrative lighting with no modeled light source; depth communicated through overlap, scale, contour density, and occasional restrained cyan glow. Avoid: no photorealism, no 3D CGI, no anime, no painterly rendering, no watercolor wash, no screen-print halftones, no collage cut edges, no dense engraving crosshatching, no neon-pop palette, no heavy gradients, no dramatic cinematic realism, no grotesque horror treatment, no decorative typography, no labels or readable text inside illustrations, and no copying of the reference image's people, campus imagery, objects, logos, text, or exact composition. No characters, no text, no logos, no photorealism. The attached operator_style_reference is style-only: use its palette, material texture, line language and lighting as inspiration for this original neutral anchor. Do not copy its subject, composition, text, logo, person, or recognizable layout.
